```{r,message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scater)
library(BiocParallel)
library(BiocSingular)
```

# Load Cellranger count

```{r,message=FALSE}
# Load 10x dataset
x <- DropletUtils::read10xCounts("apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE224407/GSE224407_RAW/GSM7021828_E19_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
rownames(x) <- make.unique(mcols(x)$Symbol)
```



```{r}
BPPARAM <- BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(6L,progressbar = TRUE)
x <- scater::addPerCellQC(x,BPPARAM=BPPARAM)
x <- scuttle::computeLibraryFactors(x,BPPARAM=BPPARAM)
```
